The path matrix is tracked for correctness but never actually printed or validated, so I just need to preserve its same initialization and update semantics without worrying about exact output format.\n\nFor random matrix generation and result printing, I'm thinking rank 0 should handle printing/validation of the full distance matrix, and for initialization I want each rank to only hold its own row-block (n²/P memory) rather than the full n² matrix, which means I need a way to replicate the rand_r stream per-rank without generating the whole matrix everywhere.\n\nFor the Floyd-Warshall parallelization itself, I'm settling on row-block distribution where each rank owns a contiguous set of rows, and for each pivot k the owning rank broadcasts just that row of the distance matrix — path updates stay fully local since they only depend on data already within each row, so only one broadcast of n values is needed per iteration.\n\nI'm also considering a pipelining optimization using MPI_Ibcast: the owner of the next pivot row would update it first and start broadcasting it asynchronously while other ranks finish their current iteration's updates, overlapping communication with computation to hide broadcast latency across iterations.\n\nThat previous buffer's Ibcast for row k was already waited on at the start of this iteration, so reuse is safe. Non-owners of row k+1 just need to post their Ibcast receive in the same call order as root, since MPI collectives must match across ranks.\n\nChecking the timing: the owner of row k+1 updates it with pivot k at iteration k-1, so by iteration k's Ibcast it's fully current through iteration k-1, exactly what's needed for the next pivot step.\n\nI'm also confirming that local path updates stay correct per-row, and thinking through whether reading dist[i][k] and dist[k][j] mid-iteration can cause inconsistency compared to the original in-place Floyd-Warshall, since those values shouldn't change during iteration k itself.\n\nI'm thinking about storing local rows row-major for cache efficiency, so the inner loop over j updating D[i][j] against the pivot row vectorizes cleanly, unlike the original's column-major layout.\n\nFor output, rank 0 needs the full matrix gathered via MPI_Gatherv only when printing or validating, and I'll keep the distributed path computation even though it's unused, just to preserve the original's semantics and cost.\n\nTiming should wrap only the floydWarshall compute, with a barrier before and after, then taking the max elapsed time across ranks via an MPI reduction, printed from rank 0 using the same millisecond duration_cast formatting as the original. I should also double check how the code handles an invalid or zero node count input.\n\nFor n=0, everything should degenerate gracefully—empty vectors, no-op loops, validation trivially passing, and output printing zero elements—so I need to make sure all ranks still participate in collectives even with zero local rows. For block distribution, I'm working out how to assign row ownership using a base/remainder split across ranks, likely via a precomputed owner array or a direct formula per row index.\n\nRelying on compiler auto-vectorization with native arch flags for the relaxation loop, updating distances and path pointers when a shorter path is found.\n\nUsing local pointers should let the compiler add alias checks without issue, and there's no INF check needed since the original Floyd-Warshall doesn't have one either—when row i equals k there's naturally no change. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792948217898,"sessionID":"ses_e8bf6edfcffeX6GM8p55ufezwY","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01MQHfZ8BmrmWr7232Kajf2G","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r1/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\n// Block-row distribution: rank r owns rows [rowStartOf(r), rowStartOf(r) + rowCountOf(r)).\n// The first (n % P) ranks receive one extra row.\ninline size_t rowStartOf(const int rank, const size_t n, const int P) noexcept {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t base = n / static_cast<size_t>(P);\n    const size_t rem = n % static_cast<size_t>(P);\n    return r * base + std::min(r, rem);\n}\n\ninline size_t rowCountOf(const int rank, const size_t n, const int P) noexcept {\n    return n / static_cast<size_t>(P) + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < n % static_cast<size_t>(P) ? 1 : 0);\n}\n\ninline int rowOwner(const size_t row, const size_t n, const int P) noexcept {\n    const size_t base = n / static_cast<size_t>(P);\n    const size_t rem = n % static_cast<size_t>(P);\n    const size_t bigSpan = rem * (base + 1);\n    if (row < bigSpan) {\n        return static_cast<int>(row / (base + 1));\n    }\n    return static_cast<int>(rem + (row - bigSpan) / base);\n}\n\n// Generates the full random stream in global row-major order (identical on every rank),\n// but stores only the locally owned rows [rowStart, rowStart + rowCount).\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax,\n                              const size_t rowStart, const size_t rowCount) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    const size_t rowEnd = rowStart + rowCount;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        const bool local = (i >= rowStart && i < rowEnd);\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int value = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n            if (local) {\n                dist[(i - rowStart) * numNodes + j] = value;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = rowStart; i < rowEnd; ++i) {\n        dist[(i - rowStart) * numNodes + i] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Initial path[i][j] = i for every entry (local rows only)\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes,\n                          const size_t rowStart, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < rowCount; ++li) {\n        const unsigned int src = static_cast<unsigned int>(rowStart + li);\n        unsigned int* row = &path[li * numNodes];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n            row[j] = src;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Relaxes one row i against pivot row k: row[j] = min(row[j], dik + pivot[j]).\n// Since dist[k][k] == 0, row k and column k are invariant during iteration k,\n// so using a snapshot of the pivot row yields exactly the sequential result.\ninline void relaxRow(unsigned int* __restrict row, unsigned int* __restrict pathRow,\n                     const unsigned int* __restrict pivot, const size_t n,\n                     const unsigned int dik, const unsigned int k) noexcept {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const unsigned int newDist = dik + pivot[j];\n        const unsigned int oldDist = row[j];\n        const bool improved = newDist < oldDist;\n        row[j] = improved ? newDist : oldDist;\n        pathRow[j] = improved ? k : pathRow[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Distributed Floyd-Warshall over MPI. Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows.\n// Iteration k needs pivot row k, which is broadcast from its owner. The broadcast of\n// row k+1 is started (non-blocking) before the bulk of iteration k's work, so that it\n// overlaps with the local computation.\nvoid floydWarshallMPI(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                      std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                      const size_t numNodes,\n                      const int rank, const int size,\n                      const size_t rowStart, const size_t rowCount) {\n    if (numNodes == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const int n = static_cast<int>(numNodes);\n    const size_t none = static_cast<size_t>(-1);\n\n    // Double-buffered pivot rows\n    std::vector<unsigned int> pivot[2] = {std::vector<unsigned int>(numNodes),\n                                          std::vector<unsigned int>(numNodes)};\n\n    // Pivot row 0\n    {\n        const int owner = rowOwner(0, numNodes, size);\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            std::copy_n(&dist[0], numNodes, pivot[0].data());\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot[0].data(), n, MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        const unsigned int* cur = pivot[k & 1].data();\n        const unsigned int kk = static_cast<unsigned int>(k);\n\n        MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n        size_t doneLocal = none;\n\n        if (k + 1 < numNodes) {\n            const size_t nk = k + 1;\n            const int nextOwner = rowOwner(nk, numNodes, size);\n            unsigned int* nxt = pivot[nk & 1].data();\n\n            if (rank == nextOwner) {\n                // Advance the next pivot row first so it can be broadcast early\n                const size_t li = nk - rowStart;\n                unsigned int* row = &dist[li * numNodes];\n                relaxRow(row, &path[li * numNodes], cur, numNodes, row[k], kk);\n                std::copy_n(row, numNodes, nxt);\n                doneLocal = li;\n            }\n\n            MPI_Ibcast(nxt, n, MPI_UNSIGNED, nextOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req);\n        }\n\n        // Relax all remaining local rows against pivot row k\n        for (size_t li = 0; li < rowCount; ++li) {\n            if (li == doneLocal) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            unsigned int* row = &dist[li * numNodes];\n            relaxRow(row, &path[li * numNodes], cur, numNodes, row[k], kk);\n        }\n\n        if (req != MPI_REQUEST_NULL) {\n            MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Runs the benchmark on all ranks. Returns the exit code (meaningful on rank 0).\nint runBenchmark(const size_t numNodes, const bool validate, const bool printResults,\n                 const int rank, const int size) {\n    const bool isRoot = (rank == 0);\n    const size_t rowStart = rowStartOf(rank, numNodes, size);\n    const size_t rowCount = rowCountOf(rank, numNodes, size);\n\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n    }\n\n    // Allocate local row blocks\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(rowCount * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(rowCount * numNodes);\n\n    // Initialize\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    }\n    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE, rowStart, rowCount);\n    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes, rowStart, rowCount);\n\n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    if (isRoot) {\n        printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    floydWarshallMPI(dist, path, numNodes, rank, size, rowStart, rowCount);\n\n    const double localSeconds = MPI_Wtime() - t0;\n    double seconds = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localSeconds, &seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (!isRoot) {\n        // Gather below is collective only when results are needed\n    }\n\n    // Gather full matrix on root only when it is needed for output or validation\n    std::vector<unsigned int> full;\n    if ((printResults || validate) && numNodes > 0) {\n        if (isRoot) {\n            full.resize(numNodes * numNodes);\n        }\n        std::vector<int> counts(size), displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rowCountOf(r, numNodes, size));\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rowStartOf(r, numNodes, size));\n        }\n        MPI_Datatype rowType;\n        MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rowType);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n        MPI_Gatherv(dist.data(), static_cast<int>(rowCount), rowType,\n                    full.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), rowType,\n                    0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    }\n\n    int rc = 0;\n    if (isRoot) {\n        const auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n            std::chrono::duration<double>(seconds));\n\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n\n        // Calculate operations per second\n        // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n        double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n        double gflops = ops / seconds / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n\n        // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results_int(full, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n        }\n\n        // Validation\n        if (validate) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            bool valid = validateResult(full, numNodes);\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n                rc = 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return rc;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    int rc = -1;  // -1: continue to benchmark\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            rc = 0;\n            break;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            rc = 1;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rc < 0) {\n        rc = runBenchmark(numNodes, validate, printResults, rank, size);\n    }\n\n    // Propagate the root's exit status so all ranks agree\n    MPI_Bcast(&rc, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r1/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r1/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","time":{"start":1792948217816,"end":1792948217870}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1740a6b63001DZDHQEU3jg6kT9","sessionID":"ses_e8bf6edfcffeX6GM8p55ufezwY","messageID":"msg_1740a6764001hc3e4mwny1wFuu"}}
